## Sidebar and top bar

> A sidebar that is always there on a desktop, with the pages, the user's teams and Settings, and a bar across the top with a search field, the notifications and the signed-in user's menu.

Source: https://shadleaf.dev/0.11.0-SNAPSHOT/layouts/top-bar/

A sidebar for an application that keeps its navigation in view: the pages with their icons, a "Your teams" group with
each team's initial where a page has its icon, and Settings at the bottom (`<sl:sidebar-footer>`). It never collapses
on a desktop (`collapsible="none"`), so there is no trigger there. Across the top of the page, a
[site header](https://shadleaf.dev/0.11.0-SNAPSHOT/components/site-header.md) that stays in view while the page scrolls: a search field that takes the
free room, a notifications button and the [user menu](https://shadleaf.dev/0.11.0-SNAPSHOT/components/user-menu.md). On a phone the menu button at the
start of the bar opens the sidebar as a panel. Switch the preview to Phone to see it.

**Example: Sidebar and top bar.** A sidebar that is always there on a desktop, with the pages, the user's teams and Settings at the bottom, and a bar across the top of the page with a search field, the notifications and the signed-in user's menu. On a phone the menu button in the bar opens the sidebar as a panel.

### The layout

The whole layout file. It has what [every layout needs](https://shadleaf.dev/0.11.0-SNAPSHOT/components/application-shell.md#what-every-layout-needs).
`#slNav.current` marks the current page from the request.

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en" xmlns:th="http://www.thymeleaf.org" xmlns:sl="https://shadleaf.dev/sl"
      th:fragment="layout(pageTitle, content)">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title th:text="${pageTitle}">Page</title>
  <th:block th:replace="~{sl/layout :: theme-script}"></th:block>
  <th:block th:replace="~{sl/layout :: assets}"></th:block>
  <link rel="stylesheet" th:href="@{/css/application.css}">
</head>
<body>
<sl:skip-link/>
<sl:sidebar-provider>
  <sl:sidebar collapsible="none">
    <sl:sidebar-header>
      <sl:sidebar-menu>
        <sl:sidebar-menu-item>
          <sl:sidebar-menu-button th:href="@{/}" size="lg">
            <sl:slot name="icon-start"><span class="app-logo"><sl:icon name="leaf"/></span></sl:slot>
            <strong>Acme</strong>
          </sl:sidebar-menu-button>
        </sl:sidebar-menu-item>
      </sl:sidebar-menu>
    </sl:sidebar-header>
    <sl:sidebar-content>
      <sl:sidebar-group id="nav-main">
        <sl:sidebar-group-content>
          <sl:sidebar-menu>
            <sl:sidebar-menu-item>
              <sl:sidebar-menu-button th:href="@{/}" th:active="${#slNav.current('/')}">
                <sl:slot name="icon-start"><sl:icon name="house"/></sl:slot>
                Dashboard
              </sl:sidebar-menu-button>
            </sl:sidebar-menu-item>
            <sl:sidebar-menu-item>
              <sl:sidebar-menu-button th:href="@{/users}" th:active="${#slNav.current('/users')}">
                <sl:slot name="icon-start"><sl:icon name="user"/></sl:slot>
                Users
              </sl:sidebar-menu-button>
            </sl:sidebar-menu-item>
            <sl:sidebar-menu-item>
              <sl:sidebar-menu-button th:href="@{/teams}" th:active="${#slNav.current('/teams')}">
                <sl:slot name="icon-start"><sl:icon name="users"/></sl:slot>
                Teams
              </sl:sidebar-menu-button>
            </sl:sidebar-menu-item>
            <sl:sidebar-menu-item>
              <sl:sidebar-menu-button th:href="@{/calendar}" th:active="${#slNav.current('/calendar')}">
                <sl:slot name="icon-start"><sl:icon name="calendar"/></sl:slot>
                Calendar
              </sl:sidebar-menu-button>
            </sl:sidebar-menu-item>
            <sl:sidebar-menu-item>
              <sl:sidebar-menu-button th:href="@{/documents}" th:active="${#slNav.current('/documents')}">
                <sl:slot name="icon-start"><sl:icon name="files"/></sl:slot>
                Documents
              </sl:sidebar-menu-button>
            </sl:sidebar-menu-item>
            <sl:sidebar-menu-item>
              <sl:sidebar-menu-button th:href="@{/reports}" th:active="${#slNav.current('/reports')}">
                <sl:slot name="icon-start"><sl:icon name="chart-pie"/></sl:slot>
                Reports
              </sl:sidebar-menu-button>
            </sl:sidebar-menu-item>
          </sl:sidebar-menu>
        </sl:sidebar-group-content>
      </sl:sidebar-group>
      <sl:sidebar-group id="nav-teams">
        <sl:sidebar-group-label>Your teams</sl:sidebar-group-label>
        <sl:sidebar-group-content>
          <sl:sidebar-menu>
            <sl:sidebar-menu-item>
              <sl:sidebar-menu-button th:href="@{/teams/engineering}" th:active="${#slNav.current('/teams/engineering')}">
                <sl:slot name="icon-start"><span class="team-initial" aria-hidden="true">E</span></sl:slot>
                Engineering
              </sl:sidebar-menu-button>
            </sl:sidebar-menu-item>
            <sl:sidebar-menu-item>
              <sl:sidebar-menu-button th:href="@{/teams/marketing}" th:active="${#slNav.current('/teams/marketing')}">
                <sl:slot name="icon-start"><span class="team-initial" aria-hidden="true">M</span></sl:slot>
                Marketing
              </sl:sidebar-menu-button>
            </sl:sidebar-menu-item>
            <sl:sidebar-menu-item>
              <sl:sidebar-menu-button th:href="@{/teams/sales}" th:active="${#slNav.current('/teams/sales')}">
                <sl:slot name="icon-start"><span class="team-initial" aria-hidden="true">S</span></sl:slot>
                Sales
              </sl:sidebar-menu-button>
            </sl:sidebar-menu-item>
          </sl:sidebar-menu>
        </sl:sidebar-group-content>
      </sl:sidebar-group>
    </sl:sidebar-content>
    <sl:sidebar-footer>
      <sl:sidebar-menu>
        <sl:sidebar-menu-item>
          <sl:sidebar-menu-button th:href="@{/settings}" th:active="${#slNav.current('/settings')}">
            <sl:slot name="icon-start"><sl:icon name="settings"/></sl:slot>
            Settings
          </sl:sidebar-menu-button>
        </sl:sidebar-menu-item>
      </sl:sidebar-menu>
    </sl:sidebar-footer>
  </sl:sidebar>
  <sl:sidebar-inset>
    <sl:site-header>
      <sl:sidebar-trigger aria-label="Menu"><sl:icon name="menu"/></sl:sidebar-trigger>
      <sl:separator orientation="vertical"/>
      <form class="app-search" role="search" th:action="@{/search}">
        <sl:input type="search" name="q" placeholder="Search" aria-label="Search"/>
        <sl:icon name="search"/>
      </form>
      <sl:slot name="end">
        <sl:button as="a" th:href="@{/notifications}" variant="ghost" size="icon" aria-label="Notifications">
          <sl:icon name="bell"/>
        </sl:button>
        <sl:separator orientation="vertical"/>
        <sl:user-menu placement="header">
          <sl:dropdown-menu-item as="a" th:href="@{/profile}"><sl:icon name="user"/>Your profile</sl:dropdown-menu-item>
        </sl:user-menu>
      </sl:slot>
    </sl:site-header>
    <div class="page">
      <h1 th:text="${pageTitle}"></h1>
      <div th:replace="${content}"></div>
    </div>
  </sl:sidebar-inset>
</sl:sidebar-provider>
<div id="modal-root"></div>
<sl:toaster>
  <sl:toast th:each="toast : ${toasts}" th:title="${toast.title}" th:description="${toast.description}"
            th:variant="${toast.variant}" th:duration="${toast.duration}"/>
</sl:toaster>
</body>
</html>
```

The search field is a plain `GET` form; Shadleaf has no search of its own. The notifications button is a link to a
page here; give it a [badge](https://shadleaf.dev/0.11.0-SNAPSHOT/components/badge.md) or open a [popover](https://shadleaf.dev/0.11.0-SNAPSHOT/components/popover.md) from it as the
application needs. The teams are links; an application lists its own with `th:each` and takes the initial with
`${#strings.substring(team.name, 0, 1)}`.

### A page

A page passes its title and its content:

```html
<html xmlns:th="http://www.thymeleaf.org" xmlns:sl="https://shadleaf.dev/sl"
      th:replace="~{layout/main :: layout('Users', ~{::#page-content})}">
<body>
<div id="page-content">
  ...
</div>
</body>
</html>
```

### The CSS

Shadleaf's CSS styles the components, not the page around them, and has no utility classes. The rest is the
application's CSS, here without Tailwind: the square behind the logo, the teams' initials, the bar (its height, the
border below it and staying in view), the search field without a border until it has focus, and the page's padding.

```css
/* The square behind the logo in the sidebar's header. */
.app-logo {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  inline-size: 2rem;
  block-size: 2rem;
  border-radius: calc(var(--radius) - 2px);
  background: var(--sidebar-primary);
  color: var(--sidebar-primary-foreground);
}
.app-logo > svg { inline-size: 1rem; block-size: 1rem; }

/* A team's initial in a small bordered square, where a page has its icon. */
.team-initial {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  inline-size: 1.25rem;
  block-size: 1.25rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--sidebar-border);
  border-radius: calc(var(--radius) - 4px);
  background: var(--background);
  font-size: 0.625rem;
  font-weight: 500;
}

/*
  The bar: as high as the sidebar's header, so the two line up, and it stays at the top while the page scrolls,
  with a border below. The separator after the menu button goes with it, from 768 px; the one before the user's menu
  is a little taller.
*/
.sidebar-inset > .site-header {
  --site-header-height: 4rem;
  position: sticky;
  inset-block-start: 0;
  z-index: 10;
  gap: 1rem;
  border-block-end: 1px solid var(--border);
  background: var(--background);
}
.sidebar-inset > .site-header > .site-header-end > .separator { block-size: 1.5rem; }
@media (width >= 48rem) {
  .sidebar-inset > .site-header > .separator { display: none; }
}

/* The search field takes the bar's free room, a magnifier inside it, without a border until it has focus. */
.app-search { position: relative; flex: 1; }
.app-search > .input { padding-inline-start: 2rem; }
.app-search > .input:not(:focus-visible) { border-color: transparent; box-shadow: none; }
.app-search > svg {
  position: absolute;
  inset-inline-start: 0.5rem;
  inset-block-start: 50%;
  translate: 0 -50%;
  inline-size: 1rem;
  block-size: 1rem;
  opacity: 0.5;
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* The page's padding, more on a wider screen. */
.page { padding: 2rem 1rem; }
.page > h1 { margin-block-end: 1.5rem; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; }
@media (width >= 64rem) {
  .page { padding: 2.5rem 2rem; }
}
```

## On the end

> A table of contents in a sidebar on the end of the line, the right in a left-to-right page, with the trigger at the end of the page's header.

Source: https://shadleaf.dev/0.11.0-SNAPSHOT/layouts/sidebar-end/

A sidebar on the end of the line (`side="right"`): the right, or the left on a right-to-left page (`dir="rtl"`). Here
it holds a table of contents under a group label, with the sections and their pages in sub-menus. The trigger is at
the end of the page's header, in the [site header](https://shadleaf.dev/0.11.0-SNAPSHOT/components/site-header.md)'s `end` slot, on the same side as
the sidebar; its icon shows a panel on that side. On a phone the panel slides in from the end.

**Example: On the end.** A table of contents on the end of the line: the right, or the left on a right-to-left page. The sidebar comes after the page in the markup, so the keyboard reaches the page first, and the trigger sits at the end of the page's header.

For reference: the [shadcn/ui block](https://ui.shadcn.com/blocks/sidebar#sidebar-14) this layout is based on.

### The layout

The whole layout file, with what [every layout needs](https://shadleaf.dev/0.11.0-SNAPSHOT/components/application-shell.md#what-every-layout-needs). The
sidebar comes after `<sl:sidebar-inset>` in the markup, as in the block, so the keyboard and a screen reader reach the
page first and the table of contents after it. `side="right"` puts it on the end either way: written before the inset,
it is still drawn there, and reached first.

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en" xmlns:th="http://www.thymeleaf.org" xmlns:sl="https://shadleaf.dev/sl"
      th:fragment="layout(pageTitle, breadcrumb, content)">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title th:text="${pageTitle}">Page</title>
  <th:block th:replace="~{sl/layout :: theme-script}"></th:block>
  <th:block th:replace="~{sl/layout :: assets}"></th:block>
  <link rel="stylesheet" th:href="@{/css/application.css}">
</head>
<body>
<sl:skip-link/>
<sl:sidebar-provider>
  <sl:sidebar-inset>
    <sl:site-header>
      <sl:breadcrumb>
        <sl:breadcrumb-list>
          <th:block th:replace="${breadcrumb}"></th:block>
        </sl:breadcrumb-list>
      </sl:breadcrumb>
      <sl:slot name="end"><sl:sidebar-trigger/></sl:slot>
    </sl:site-header>
    <div class="page">
      <h1 th:text="${pageTitle}"></h1>
      <div th:replace="${content}"></div>
    </div>
  </sl:sidebar-inset>
  <sl:sidebar side="right">
    <sl:sidebar-content>
      <sl:sidebar-group id="toc">
        <sl:sidebar-group-label>Table of Contents</sl:sidebar-group-label>
        <sl:sidebar-group-content>
          <sl:sidebar-menu class="docs-nav">
            <sl:sidebar-menu-item>
              <sl:sidebar-menu-button th:href="@{/getting-started}"
                                      th:active="${#slNav.current('/getting-started', true)}">
                Getting Started
              </sl:sidebar-menu-button>
              <sl:sidebar-menu-sub>
                <sl:sidebar-menu-sub-item>
                  <sl:sidebar-menu-sub-button th:href="@{/getting-started/installation}"
                                              th:active="${#slNav.current('/getting-started/installation')}">
                    Installation
                  </sl:sidebar-menu-sub-button>
                </sl:sidebar-menu-sub-item>
                <sl:sidebar-menu-sub-item>
                  <sl:sidebar-menu-sub-button th:href="@{/getting-started/project-structure}"
                                              th:active="${#slNav.current('/getting-started/project-structure')}">
                    Project Structure
                  </sl:sidebar-menu-sub-button>
                </sl:sidebar-menu-sub-item>
              </sl:sidebar-menu-sub>
            </sl:sidebar-menu-item>
            <sl:sidebar-menu-item>
              <sl:sidebar-menu-button th:href="@{/build}"
                                      th:active="${#slNav.current('/build', true)}">
                Build Your Application
              </sl:sidebar-menu-button>
              <sl:sidebar-menu-sub>
                <sl:sidebar-menu-sub-item>

        </sl:sidebar-group-content>
      </sl:sidebar-group>
    </sl:sidebar-content>
  </sl:sidebar>
</sl:sidebar-provider>
<div id="modal-root"></div>
<sl:toaster>
  <sl:toast th:each="toast : ${toasts}" th:title="${toast.title}" th:description="${toast.description}"
            th:variant="${toast.variant}" th:duration="${toast.duration}"/>
</sl:toaster>
</body>
</html>
```

### A page

A page passes its title, its breadcrumb's levels and its content, as for the [Sub-menus](https://shadleaf.dev/0.11.0-SNAPSHOT/layouts/sub-menus.md#a-page)
layout:

```html
<html xmlns:th="http://www.thymeleaf.org" xmlns:sl="https://shadleaf.dev/sl"
      th:replace="~{layout/main :: layout('Data Fetching', ~{::breadcrumb}, ~{::#page-content})}">
<body>
<th:block th:ref="breadcrumb">
  <sl:breadcrumb-item>
    <sl:breadcrumb-link th:href="@{/build}">Build Your Application</sl:breadcrumb-link>
  </sl:breadcrumb-item>
  <sl:breadcrumb-separator/>
  <sl:breadcrumb-item>
    <sl:breadcrumb-page>Data Fetching</sl:breadcrumb-page>
  </sl:breadcrumb-item>
</th:block>
<div id="page-content">
  ...
</div>
</body>
</html>
```

### The CSS

The weight of the sections' links, a border below the header and the page's padding:

```css
/* The sections' links in a medium weight, their pages' in the normal one. */
.docs-nav > .sidebar-menu-item > .sidebar-menu-button { font-weight: 500; }

/* A border below the page's header, and the page's padding. */
.sidebar-inset > .site-header { border-block-end: 1px solid var(--border); }
.page { padding: 1rem; }
.page > h1 { margin-block-end: 1rem; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; }
```

## Navigation in the header

> For an application with a handful of pages, the pages as a row of links in the site header and the page as a card below it; on a phone the same navigation is a panel.

Source: https://shadleaf.dev/0.11.0-SNAPSHOT/layouts/header/

For an application with a handful of pages. The [site header](https://shadleaf.dev/0.11.0-SNAPSHOT/components/site-header.md) holds the menu button
(on a phone), the application's name, the pages as a row of links, and the theme toggle and the
[user menu](https://shadleaf.dev/0.11.0-SNAPSHOT/components/user-menu.md) at the end. The page is a card below the header (`variant="inset"`).

The row is a `<sl:sidebar placement="header">`. On a phone the menu button opens that same navigation as a panel,
with the icons and the parts marked `panel-only`: here the panel's own header and a More group (Settings, Help).
Switch the preview to Phone to see it.

**Example: Navigation in the header.** For an application with a handful of pages: the pages as a row of links in the site header, the page as a card below it, the theme toggle and the signed-in user's menu at the end. On a phone the menu button opens the same navigation as a panel, with its icons and the panel-only parts.

For reference: Flux's [header layout](https://fluxui.dev/layouts/header) this layout is based on.

### The layout

The whole layout file, with what [every layout needs](https://shadleaf.dev/0.11.0-SNAPSHOT/components/application-shell.md#what-every-layout-needs). It is
the layout of the second sample application (sample-02's `layout/main.html`, which runs under a strict
Content-Security-Policy). Sample-02 also has an Admin link for admins only, left out here: see
[Navigation by role](https://shadleaf.dev/0.11.0-SNAPSHOT/components/application-shell.md#navigation-by-role).

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en" xmlns:th="http://www.thymeleaf.org" xmlns:sl="https://shadleaf.dev/sl"
      th:fragment="layout(pageTitle, content)">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title th:text="${pageTitle}">Page</title>
  <th:block th:replace="~{sl/layout :: theme-script}"></th:block>
  <th:block th:replace="~{sl/layout :: assets}"></th:block>
  <link rel="stylesheet" th:href="@{/css/application.css}">
</head>
<body>
<sl:skip-link/>
<sl:sidebar-provider>
  <sl:site-header>
    <sl:sidebar-trigger aria-label="Menu"><sl:icon name="menu"/></sl:sidebar-trigger>
    <sl:button as="a" th:href="@{/}" variant="ghost">
      <sl:slot name="icon-start"><sl:icon name="leaf"/></sl:slot>
      Acme
    </sl:button>
    <sl:sidebar placement="header" variant="inset">
      <sl:sidebar-header panel-only>
        <sl:sidebar-menu>
          <sl:sidebar-menu-item>
            <sl:sidebar-menu-button th:href="@{/}" size="lg">
              <sl:slot name="icon-start"><span class="app-logo"><sl:icon name="leaf"/></span></sl:slot>
              <strong>Acme</strong>
              <small>Enterprise</small>
            </sl:sidebar-menu-button>
          </sl:sidebar-menu-item>
        </sl:sidebar-menu>
      </sl:sidebar-header>
      <sl:sidebar-content>
        <sl:sidebar-group>
          <sl:sidebar-group-content>
            <sl:sidebar-menu>
              <sl:sidebar-menu-item>
                <sl:sidebar-menu-button th:href="@{/}" th:active="${#slNav.current('/')}">
                  <sl:slot name="icon-start"><sl:icon name="house"/></sl:slot>
                  Home
                </sl:sidebar-menu-button>
              </sl:sidebar-menu-item>
              <sl:sidebar-menu-item>
                <sl:sidebar-menu-button th:href="@{/forms}" th:active="${#slNav.current('/forms')}">
                  <sl:slot name="icon-start"><sl:icon name="text-cursor-input"/></sl:slot>
                  Forms
                </sl:sidebar-menu-button>
              </sl:sidebar-menu-item>
              <sl:sidebar-menu-item>
                <sl:sidebar-menu-button th:href="@{/overlays}" th:active="${#slNav.current('/overlays')}">
                  <sl:slot name="icon-start"><sl:icon name="layers"/></sl:slot>
                  Overlays
                </sl:sidebar-menu-button>
              </sl:sidebar-menu-item>
              <sl:sidebar-menu-item>
                <sl:sidebar-menu-button th:href="@{/data}" th:active="${#slNav.current('/data')}">
                  <sl:slot name="icon-start"><sl:icon name="table"/></sl:slot>
                  Data
                </sl:sidebar-menu-button>
              </sl:sidebar-menu-item>
            </sl:sidebar-menu>
          </sl:sidebar-group-content>
        </sl:sidebar-group>
        <sl:sidebar-group id="nav-more" panel-only>
          <sl:sidebar-group-label>More</sl:sidebar-group-label>
          <sl:sidebar-group-content>
            <sl:sidebar-menu>
              <sl:sidebar-menu-item>
                <sl:sidebar-menu-button th:href="@{/settings}" th:active="${#slNav.current('/settings')}">
                  <sl:slot name="icon-start"><sl:icon name="settings"/></sl:slot>
                  Settings
                </sl:sidebar-menu-button>
              </sl:sidebar-menu-item>
              <sl:sidebar-menu-item>
                <sl:sidebar-menu-button th:href="@{/help}" th:active="${#slNav.current('/help')}">
                  <sl:slot name="icon-start"><sl:icon name="life-buoy"/></sl:slot>
                  Help
                </sl:sidebar-menu-button>
              </sl:sidebar-menu-item>
            </sl:sidebar-menu>
          </sl:sidebar-group-content>
        </sl:sidebar-group>
      </sl:sidebar-content>
    </sl:sidebar>
    <sl:slot name="end">
      <sl:theme-toggle/>
      <sl:user-menu placement="header">
        <sl:dropdown-menu-item as="a" th:href="@{/settings}"><sl:icon name="settings"/>Settings</sl:dropdown-menu-item>
      </sl:user-menu>
    </sl:slot>
  </sl:site-header>
  <sl:sidebar-inset>
    <div class="page">
      <h1 th:text="${pageTitle}"></h1>
      <div th:replace="${content}"></div>
    </div>
  </sl:sidebar-inset>
</sl:sidebar-provider>
<div id="modal-root"></div>
<sl:toaster>
  <sl:toast th:each="toast : ${toasts}" th:title="${toast.title}" th:description="${toast.description}"
            th:variant="${toast.variant}" th:duration="${toast.duration}"/>
</sl:toaster>
</body>
</html>
```

In the row, the links show their labels without icons and the current page is marked as in a sidebar; group actions,
separators and collapsible items are left out of the row, and the menu button is hidden on a desktop. When the links do
not fit, the row scrolls sideways. See [In the header](https://shadleaf.dev/0.11.0-SNAPSHOT/components/sidebar.md#in-the-header) and
[Panel-only parts](https://shadleaf.dev/0.11.0-SNAPSHOT/components/sidebar.md#panel-only-parts).

### A page

A page passes its title and its content:

```html
<html xmlns:th="http://www.thymeleaf.org" xmlns:sl="https://shadleaf.dev/sl"
      th:replace="~{layout/main :: layout('Forms', ~{::#page-content})}">
<body>
<div id="page-content">
  ...
</div>
</body>
</html>
```

### The CSS

The square behind the logo in the panel's header, and the page in the card, kept to a readable width:

```css
/* The square behind the logo in the panel's header. */
.app-logo {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  inline-size: 2rem;
  block-size: 2rem;
  border-radius: calc(var(--radius) - 2px);
  background: var(--sidebar-primary);
  color: var(--sidebar-primary-foreground);
}
.app-logo > svg { inline-size: 1rem; block-size: 1rem; }

/* The page in the card, kept to a readable width. */
.page { max-width: 48rem; padding: 1.5rem 1rem 2rem; }
.page > h1 { margin-block-end: 1rem; font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: 600; }
```
